title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — October 18, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C2.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C3.4 (Peaked October 18, 2026 at 03:53 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 518 km/s (Elevated)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

The Sun just gave us a little flare! 💥🚀

The Sun shows two clear sunspot groups and bright active-region emission, while the coronagraph shows no unambiguous large outward structure.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
